items.title: Will AI Take Our Jobs or Change How We Think About Work? @shenaztreasury..  #Shorts
items.summary: Will AI take our jobs, reshape them or change the way we think about work altogether? That question sparked a fascinating conversation at Cypher 2026, with **Shenaz Treasury** and fellow speakers exploring the impact of AI on employment, human purpose and the future of society. The discussion touched on the need to upskill and learn to work alongside AI, the possibility of people taking on multiple roles, and the deeper question of what happens to society if technology advances faster than our ability to adapt. It also went into a more unsettling territory: what happens if AI eventually surpasses human intelligence and begins making decisions about humanity itself? AI is changing the future of work. items.summary_html:
Will AI take our jobs, reshape them or change the way we think about work altogether? That question sparked a fascinating conversation at Cypher 2026, with **Shenaz Treasury** and fellow speakers exploring the impact of AI on employment, human purpose and the future of society.

The discussion touched on the need to upskill and learn to work alongside AI, the possibility of people taking on multiple roles, and the deeper question of what happens to society if technology advances faster than our ability to adapt. It also went into a more unsettling territory: what happens if AI eventually surpasses human intelligence and begins making decisions about humanity itself?

AI is changing the future of work. The bigger question is how we choose to shape that future.
